comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. lat/lon are real OSM coordinates, projected at runtime via road.project(). radius is trigger distance in compressed-world meters (route is scaled to ~30% of real distance). needs_owner_review:true marks entries requiring verification against the owner's lived knowledge — map data is a start, not the final word.
